fields.label: Authentication source
fields.help: Global mappings affect all databases using the security database; local mappings affect this database only. Global changes also require authority in the security database; a local role grant alone does not grant it. A mapping does not install or enable an auth plugin. Native exact matches precede wildcard matching; conflicting destinations can reject login. Test a fresh attachment.

fields.label: Plugin name
fields.help: Required for PLUGIN; empty for other source modes.

fields.label: Source database or alias
fields.help: Optional IN identifier, not allowed with SERVERWIDE.

fields.label: Source identity type
fields.help: Native plugin identity type, for example USER, GROUP or Predefined_Group. Case is preserved.

fields.label: Source name
fields.help: Required unless Any source name is selected. A literal * is not a named identity in Firebird mappings.

fields.label: Target name
fields.help: Empty preserves the original source name. Do not enter *.

notes: Firebird authentication-mapping engine_object form aligned with provider visual_admin contract (owner direction 2026-10-29, ui_unified_design.rst decision 15).
